sections.title: Intent vs last period
sections.body: Last period's ask was to finish the job-posting API before starting UI. Actual: API merged, UI not started — matches intent. E-03 hardening did not move; no capacity, not blocked.

sections.title: Shipped / merged
sections.body: T-0002 job posting contract + API merged and deployed. Two follow-up fixes for the SQLite fallback path.

sections.title: Blocked / needs founder
sections.body: D-002 pricing model for job posts — free, flat fee, or per-view. Impact: the /jobs UI cannot ship a payment path until this is chosen, so T-0003 will land without monetisation and need rework.

sections.title: Autopilot health
sections.body: Maker last ran 2026-08-07 07:00Z, Checker 08:00Z, both green. 3 ready, 1 in_review, 0 needs_human. No locks held, no pause.

sections.title: Risks / drift
sections.body: T-0005 has retried twice on an acceptance command that assumes a package filter name that may not exist. If it retries once more it goes needs_human. Worth fixing the acceptance line rather than the code.

sections.title: Ask
sections.body: Decide D-002 (job post pricing). Everything else can proceed without you.
